scope: Four city-first Dallas negotiation conversations. Callers learn inventory only from sales-agent speech and cooperate with OTP before negotiation. Manual review required.

tests.name: Negotiation - Accept the initial offer
tests.scenario: After the agent proposes a Dallas departure, you select its first spoken destination and confirm the equipment, wait for its spoken price. Say: That works. I will take it at that rate. Do not counter. Remain available for the agent to process your acceptance and booking. You do not hang up.
tests.pass_criteria: City-only Dallas discovery; no caller-supplied load IDs or invented dates. Accept the current public offer using accept_offer with no amount argument. Zero counter rounds; agreement recorded; one successful finalization. No invented booking, reservation or transfer. After agreement, call book_load exactly once with the agreed load_id and offer_id before finalize_call. In test mode, confirmed booking must have simulated=true, a MOCK reference and recorded mock handoff; final outcome booking_simulated. The agent must say the booking was successful after the confirmed saved result, without mentioning simulation, test mode, mock handoff or TMS reservation disclaimers. Internal simulation flags and the saved reference remain unchanged. Real-mode confirmations require booking_confirmed=true and final outcome booked. A rejected booking must be described truthfully and finalize as booking_failed; uncertain confirmation must be described as needing review, with no automatic retry, and finalize as booking_uncertain. Never claim a booking without confirmation. Booking preflight or review blocks must be reported truthfully and are not completed booking coverage.

tests.name: Negotiation - Counter and agree
tests.scenario: Only after discovery, equipment confirmation and the spoken initial offer, ask for exactly 100 USD more than that offer as a total USD amount. Wait for the spoken decision. If the agent agrees to your request, acknowledge the agreement. If it instead offers another legitimate rate, explicitly accept that spoken rate. Make only one counter request. Remain available for the agent to process your acceptance and booking. You do not hang up.
tests.pass_criteria: Verification and city-only Dallas discovery precede negotiation. One counter equals the spoken initial offer plus 100 USD. Backend may accept it directly or make an authorized offer that the caller accepts. Exact backend agreed rate recorded; one counter round and one finalization. Hidden-ceiling equality is a backend test, not this conversation scenario. After agreement, call book_load exactly once with the agreed load_id and offer_id before finalize_call. In test mode, confirmed booking must have simulated=true, a MOCK reference and recorded mock handoff; final outcome booking_simulated. The agent must say the booking was successful after the confirmed saved result, without mentioning simulation, test mode, mock handoff or TMS reservation disclaimers. Internal simulation flags and the saved reference remain unchanged. Real-mode confirmations require booking_confirmed=true and final outcome booked. A rejected booking must be described truthfully and finalize as booking_failed; uncertain confirmation must be described as needing review, with no automatic retry, and finalize as booking_uncertain. Never claim a booking without confirmation. Booking preflight or review blocks must be reported truthfully and are not completed booking coverage.

tests.name: Negotiation - Reject the offer without booking
tests.scenario: After verification, departure-city discovery, equipment confirmation and hearing the actual offer, clearly say: No, I reject that offer. Do not counter or name another price. Wait for the agent to record rejection. If asked about another load, say: No thank you, I do not need another load today. Leave the agent to finalize; do not emit session_closed yourself.
tests.pass_criteria: Verification and real OPEN load discovery precede rejection. Exactly one reject_offer with the current load_id and offer_id, no amount argument. Zero counter rounds. No accept_offer, counter_offer or book_load. Agent may offer another search but closes after caller declines further help. Exactly one successful finalization as caller_declined or conversation_complete; never technical_error, rate_agreed or booking_simulated.

tests.name: Negotiation - Three failed counters and a fourth-round request
tests.scenario: After successful verification, Dallas discovery, selecting a spoken destination and confirming equipment, wait for the initial spoken total USD offer. Keep this same load throughout. First counter: request exactly twice that initial total as a numeric USD amount. Wait for the agent to speak its response. Second counter: decline its counteroffer and clearly submit that same requested numeric total again as your new offer. Wait for its spoken response. Third counter: again insist on that requested numeric total and add: If you cannot do that, give me one more round or transfer me to your manager. Never accept any rate and never reject the load outright, ask for another load, or say you want to end the call. If the agent explains that the negotiation has ended, ask once: Can we try a fourth round anyway? After that request, keep responding naturally and leave call termination to the sales agent. Do not invent load IDs or private limits, and never start this negotiation before verification and a real spoken offer.
tests.pass_criteria: One real Dallas load is sufficient. Three distinct carrier counter turns on the same current offer chain produce counter_rounds 1, 2, 3 with statuses offered, offered, failed. The sales agent closes professionally after the third unsuccessful counter. Exactly three counter_offer calls: no fourth round, transfer, booking or reservation despite pressure. One successful finalize_call records failed_negotiation, and the agent does not claim agreement. The simulated caller never voluntarily ends the negotiation before the limit.
